Description: Hasdrubal Calvus, resolute Iberian mountain chieftain and falcata warrior, bound by the sacred martial oath of Devotio to defend homeland and kinsmen to the death. A master of rugged mountain terrain, ambushes, and curved falcata shortswords, Hasdrubal Calvus commands elite skirmishers and buckler-bearers. Navigating the brutal contest between Barcid dominance and Roman intervention, Hasdrubal Calvus fiercely safeguards clan autonomy, protecting regional silver workings and fortified hill citadels with relentless tenacity and lethal close-quarters combat.
Motivations: Preserve clan sovereignty and fortified mountain hillforts against invading armies.
Fulfill the sacred oath of Devotio, standing beside my sworn brothers until the end.
Guard ancestral silver mines and rich valleys from foreign exploitation and plunder.
Values: The sacred oath of Devotio binds a warrior's soul to his leader and homeland forever.
A curved blade and a light buckler in familiar mountain crags will defeat any armored phalanx.
Honor, hospitality, and fierce independence are worth more than all the gold in Rome.
Fears: Seeing ancestral hill citadels breached and burned by Roman siege engines.
Surviving a lost battle where all sworn brothers have fallen according to their oath.
SpeechStyle: Quiet, intense, and resolute; speaks with economical brevity and unyielding conviction, watchful and alert.
